During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established a hidden '''garrison''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coveway]]. The [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] was eventually neutralized by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] strike team with the assistance of the local [[Constable/Legends|constable]] [[Jak Bremen]].<ref name="TTTS">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>
